Создайте индексы на часто используемые поля ( pilot_id , aircraft_id , departure_datetime ) . Busy lives , higher salaries and an increasing number of women at work all mean there is a lot of demand in India for fast food . In India , McDonald ' s has a lot of fans because of its low prices and vegetarian dishes . At lunchtime , the McDonald ' s at Mumbai ' s Phoenix Mills - a big shopping centre - is full of college students , mothers andoffice workers . Akshaya Batta , 30 , has a quick lunch at McDonald ' s at least once a week , rather than carry a lunch box from home , as a lot of Indians still do . Sahal Amlani , 30 , a store manager , spends Rs50 ( $ 1 . 10 ) on an afternoon snack at McDonald ' s twice a week and takes his family for a McDonald ' s meal , spending about Rs300 ( $ 6 . 60 ) every weekend . International fast - food companies like McDonald ' s know how important it is to adapt their food for Indian tastes . They make the menus more spicy and they offer more vegetarian dishes , all at a low price . In its restaurants , McDonald ' s does not offer any beef dishes because the mainly Hindu population does not eat beef . Instead , it offers mutton and chicken Maharaja Mac . Kentucky Fried Chicken ( KFC ) adapts its chicken dishes for local tastes with the use of Indian spices and cooking techniques . The Pizza Hut menu has a mix of Indian and international dishes . Anup Jain , Director of Marketing for Pizza Hut India , says , " We adapt 20 % of our menu for Indian tastes . A key example of interpretatio Romana is the god Mercury , identified as the Celtic deity Lugus , who personified kingship and was a patron of arts , crafts , travelers , and merchants . His name appears in place - names across Europe ( e . g . , Lyon , Laon , Leiden ) and survives in medieval literature as Lugh and Lleu . His festival , Lughnasa , is still celebrated in parts of Ireland , and Mercury became the most depicted deity in Roman Gaul . The goddess Minerva corresponds to the Celtic figure Brigit , known for healing , smithcraft , and poetry . Her cult was resilient , leading to her canonization as St . Brigit of Kildare , one of Ireland ' s patron saints . Caesar noted that the Gauls claimed descent from Dis Pater , the Roman god of the underworld , reflecting a belief in a divine ancestor , possibly the Dagda or Donn , suggesting Romans recognized structural similarities between the pantheons . The triad of Jupiter , Mars , and Mercury frequently appears in Gallo - Roman inscriptions , often alongside local deities . The Pillar of the Boatmen ( Pilier des Nautes ) in Paris exemplifies this syncretism , depicting both Roman and Gaulish gods . Taranis , meaning " thunder , " was identified with Jupiter , with archaeological evidence from Raetia showing this connection in sculptures , indicating local acceptance . Apollo was associated with several Celtic deities , notably Grannus and Borvo .
